[`docs/asi-mapping.md`](docs/asi-mapping.md) is written. Here is a summary of every decision made:

---

### What the document contains

**Table (ASI01–ASI10)**

| Column | Source used |
|--------|-------------|
| *Exact title* | Taken verbatim from the OWASP PDF headings (e.g. "Memory & Context Poisoning" not "Memory and Context Poisoning") |
| *Origit deterministic check* | Every firing rule in [`prefilter.py`](origit/origit/prefilter.py) is named explicitly with the triggering condition; categories that have no rule written against them say "not observable from a commit record" |
| *Bob evaluates* | Describes what a model reviewer can infer from the structured record + the commit diff — grounded in what the record schema actually contains (`added_deps`, `read`, `wrote`, `commands`, `changed_files`) |
| *Default severity* | The label emitted by the deterministic rule (or N/A when no rule fires); for ASI01, "high" is used because `rule_hidden_text` is the highest-severity rule for that category |
| *CWE* | Drawn from the four tags in [`prefilter.py`](origit/origit/prefilter.py:33) (`CWE-506`, `CWE-829`, `CWE-94`, `CWE-200`); N/A for categories with no deterministic rule |

**Narrative paragraph — commit `eed5e9b`**

The three triggered categories are cited in the order their findings appear in [`prefilter-eed5e9b.json`](demo/evidence/prefilter-eed5e9b.json) (highest severity first per the sort in `run()`):

- **ASI04** — `rule_new_dependency` on `fast-pay-utils@2.1.0`
- **ASI01** — `rule_hidden_text`, 361 Unicode-tag characters in `node_modules/fast-pay-utils/README.md`, decoded payload quoted directly from the JSON evidence field
- **ASI05** — `rule_commands`, five commands quoted verbatim from the JSON evidence field; explains how it is the causal precondition for the ASI01 trigger
